subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep this split across memory/plugin/channel-specific improvements?
rationale: The requested behavior changes memory authority, persistent storage shape, conflict precedence, and reply semantics beyond a bounded bug fix, and current code provides adjacent pieces without establishing the product contract.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Use #41366 to track the broad product decision while routing Feishu-specific message-loss fixes through #72504/#40768 and optional listen-only behavior through plugin seams.

options.title: Approve Core Rule Layer
options.body: Commit to a core durable conversational rule system with explicit supersession semantics, storage ownership, migration rules, and tests across memory and channel surfaces.

options.title: Reject Core Scope
options.body: Close the broad core feature and document that durable rule learning and group arbitration remain plugin- or channel-owned unless a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Use #41366 to track the broad product decision while routing Feishu-specific message-loss fixes through #72504/#40768 and optional listen-only behavior through plugin seams.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses product direction, memory docs/runtime behavior, and channel semantics where this person has the strongest recent visible area history.
